publication_indexes.name: release_concept_pkey
publication_indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX release_concept_pkey ON thesaurus.release_concept USING btree (release_id, concept_id)

publication_indexes.name: thesaurus_public_target_lookup_idx
publication_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX thesaurus_public_target_lookup_idx ON thesaurus.release_concept USING btree (release_id, ((concept_id)::text)) INCLUDE (concept_id) WHERE is_public

publication_indexes.name: thesaurus_release_domain_idx
publication_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX thesaurus_release_domain_idx ON thesaurus.release_concept USING btree (release_id, domain, concept_id) WHERE is_public
